Benefits of Donating Blood

Giving blood is good for you too — here's why

❤️

Reduces risk of heart disease

Regular blood donation helps reduce iron overload in the body, which is linked to lower risk of cardiovascular disease.

🔬

Free health screening

Every time you donate, your blood is tested for various conditions including HIV, hepatitis, and blood pressure — a free mini health check.

🏃

Burns calories

Donating one pint of blood can burn up to 650 calories as your body works to replenish the lost blood.

🧬

Stimulates blood cell production

After donating, your body produces new blood cells to replace the donated ones, keeping your system healthy and active.

😊

Psychological benefits

The act of helping others creates a sense of fulfillment and can reduce stress, improve emotional well-being, and boost self-esteem.

🌟

Save up to 3 lives

A single donation can be separated into red cells, plasma, and platelets — each saving a different patient's life.

🩺

Reduces cancer risk

Studies suggest that regular blood donation may lower the risk of certain cancers due to reduced iron levels in the body.

⚡

Liver health

Excess iron in the body can lead to liver damage. Donating blood helps maintain healthy iron levels, benefiting liver function.
